profiles.name: Azalina Othman Said
profiles.position: Minister in the Prime Minister’s Department (Law and Institutional Reform)
profiles.description: Azalina Othman Said is Minister in the Prime Minister’s Department (Law and Institutional Reform). She represents Pengerang, Johor, in the Dewan Rakyat. She is a member of UMNO.

profiles.name: Zambry Abdul Kadir
profiles.description: Zambry Abdul Kadir is Minister of Higher Education. He serves as a senator appointed by the Yang di-Pertuan Agong. He is a member of UMNO.

milestones.title: Develop and table a Freedom of Information Bill
milestones.description: Azalina said a parliamentary select committee would scrutinise the proposed Freedom of Information Bill before its tabling.
milestones.progress_note: Her September update describes committee deliberations and planned public consultation. This supports ongoing development, not enactment or operation of an access-to-information law. A final delivery date and completion percentage were not established.

milestones.title: Submit Political Financing Bill policy proposals to the select committee
milestones.description: Azalina said prepared policy recommendations for drafting the Political Financing Bill would be presented to the parliamentary select committee.
milestones.progress_note: The written reply describes research and stakeholder engagement already undertaken. Actual submission of these proposals was not verified in this pass; it is not treated as passage of a financing law. No exact deadline or completion percentage is assigned.

milestones.title: Develop a new law to replace AUKU
milestones.description: Zambry said the ministry was discussing a new law to replace the Universities and University Colleges Act with relevant stakeholders.
milestones.progress_note: The minister reported meetings with academics and university administrators, with student engagement to follow. The verified update supports drafting and consultation only; enactment, a firm deadline and numerical completion were not established.

methodology: Editorial records of attributable commitments and dated evidence, not endorsements or independently audited performance scores. Promise dates use explicitly stated event dates where available. Year/month-only target dates use end-of-period markers, not an invented exact-day promise. Sector ratios, budget allocations and announcements are not completion scores.
